name: Villaturde (Spain)
description: Four horizontal stripes of green, red, yellow and blue, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of Villaturde (a book and the letters I V on red, and a tree above waves on green).
history: Municipal flag of Villaturde; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Villaturde arms — book and letters I V on red, tree above waves on green
